relevance_rank_note: Endogenous APOE3 vs APOE4 (targeted replacement mouse neurons) with surface biotinylation of four receptors and receptor colocalization with Rab11 recycling endosomes; no ARF6 or recycling-rate assay, and the mice are on an alpha-synuclein knockout background.

description: Surface biotinylation followed by ELISA in primary neurons from APOE3 and APOE4 targeted replacement mice showed that the surface-to-total ratio of APOER2 was about half as large in APOE4 neurons as in APOE3 neurons.
quote: The results obtained show that the ratio of the externally oriented receptors to the total, was significantly lower in APOE4 neurons of APOER2 (Fig. 4A, 53% reduction, p < 0.05)
system: Primary neuron-enriched cultures from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein knockout background, FUDR-treated; endogenous mouse-expressed human APOE; sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface labelling, surface and total APOER2 by ELISA, ratio normalised to APOE3. Mouse primary neurons on an alpha-synuclein null background.
human_check: n = 3 cohorts, each a pool of neurons from at least two mice. Figure image checked: single star on the APOE4 bar, two-group t-test. Class 1 -> 3 (team leader, 2026-11-21): steady-state surface level is B' in the directness guide; synthesis or breakdown could also change it, so it does not measure recycling itself.
